topicFamilies.label: D2C response framework — recognize, verify, document, correct, escalate
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: Use the SPG reasoning sequence recognize -> verify patient and signal -> document -> permitted technical correction -> escalate per facility policy. Exact emergency thresholds and call chains remain local, and urgent safety action must not be delayed for documentation.

topicFamilies.label: D2C artifact and signal-quality troubleshooting
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: Verify the patient and corroborating physiology before correcting a suspicious channel. AAST Standard PSG applies to adult standard PSG only and is not pediatric, PAP, oxygen, or HSAT authority.

topicFamilies.label: D2C respiratory signal verification
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: Do not classify physiology from one failed channel. Cross-check the patient and relevant airflow, effort, oximetry, position, and signal integrity; pediatric cases follow the pediatric/infant authority route rather than adult Standard PSG authority.

topicFamilies.label: D2C ETCO2 and TcCO2 troubleshooting
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: ETCO2 and TcCO2 are distinct technologies. Current AASM rules control scoring; AAST guidance controls technical acquisition/troubleshooting context. Oximetry does not substitute for ventilation assessment.

topicFamilies.label: D2C cardiac rhythm verification and escalation
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: Teach rhythm recognition, signal verification, documentation, and facility escalation. Do not present independent diagnosis, treatment, or one universal emergency threshold as the technologist response.

topicFamilies.label: D2C treatment-related change and device response
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: Route the issue back to the treatment indication and modality. Do not improvise PAP, ASV, NIV, oxygen, or other treatment settings outside the applicable order, current guidance, facility protocol, and manufacturer instructions.

topicFamilies.label: D2C pediatric and infant troubleshooting response
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: Current AASM pediatric/infant rules and age-specific competency come first. AAST Standard PSG is not pediatric PSG authority; caregiver, safety, and escalation procedures remain facility-specific.

topicFamilies.label: D2C documentation and escalation handoff
topicFamilies.authorityBoundary: Document the observation, patient/signal verification, technical action, reassessment/response, and escalation according to local workflow. The exact call chain is facility-defined, and documentation must not delay immediate emergency response.
